notes: German tanks and infantry made several attacks on the Orne bridgehead on 10 June; 6th Airborne given the task of expanding the bridgehead east of the Orne.

notes: 5th Black Watch attack on Bréville repulsed 11 June after heavy casualties; German attacks from the Bréville area on 12 June.

notes: Held the area between the Orne and the Dives until 14 June, when 51st Highland Division took over the southern part of the Orne bridgehead.
